arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_image.py').read()
old="""        S = rng.choice([4,5,6,7,8])
        ms = rng.choice([32,32,20,40]) ; ms=min(32,ms)
        while True:"""
new="""        S = rng.choice([4,5,6,7,8])
        ms = rng.choice([32,32,20,40]) ; ms=min(32,ms)
        while S*ms < 128:
            S = rng.choice([4,5,6,7,8]); ms = rng.choice([32,32,20,40]); ms=min(32,ms)
        while True:"""
assert old in s, 'nomatch'
s=s.replace(old,new)
open('t_image.py','w').write(s)
print('patched', s.count('while S*ms < 128'))
EOF
cd /app/tmp && timeout 110 python3 -u t_image.py 5 > out.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -6 out.log
